title: Justin Champagnie on Wizards opener: 'Probably the most energy that we've had in there since I've been here'
text:
Justin Champagnie on Wizards opener: 'Probably the most energy that we've had in there since I've been here' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Justin Champagnie on Wizards opener: 'Probably the most energy that we've had in there since I've been here'
 HoopsHype Oct. 22, 2026, 12:47 p.m. ET Josh Robbins: Speaking today after practice, Justin Champagnie lauded the fans who were inside the arena last night. He said there was "probably the most energy that we've had in there since I've been here. So, it was definitely a plus. ... It was fun yesterday, for sure."
